description: This file provides utility methods for constructing file paths and URLs within the sales management system, such as static content paths, store URIs, customer URIs, admin URIs, category URLs, and product URLs. It also handles external resource references like store configuration and request data.

classes.name: FilePathUtils
classes.description: A utility class for constructing various types of file and URL paths used within the web application, including static paths for resources, store URLs, customer URLs, admin URLs, category URLs, and product URLs.

methods.name: buildStaticFilePath
methods.description: Constructs the filesystem path for static content files, such as images, based on store code and image name.

methods.name: buildAdminDownloadProductFilePath
methods.description: Builds the file path to download a digital product associated with a store in the admin context.

methods.name: buildOrderDownloadProductFilePath
methods.description: Creates the URL for downloading a product within an order, given store, order download info, and order ID.

methods.name: buildStoreUri
methods.description: Generates the base URI for a store, considering request context and configurations.

methods.name: buildStoreUri
methods.description: Overloaded method: generates the store URI given store and a context path string.

methods.name: buildCustomerUri
methods.description: Builds the URI to the customer dashboard or section of the store.

methods.name: buildAdminUri
methods.description: Constructs the URI for the admin section of the store, based on request session configurations.

methods.name: buildCategoryUrl
methods.description: Creates the full URL for a category page within the store.

methods.name: buildProductUrl
methods.description: Constructs the URL for a specific product page within the store.
